'''Ko Sai''', a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]], was [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of the creation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. She was a skilled genetic engineer.

==Biography==
Ko Sai was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]], born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and genetic engineer. She once met with [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] individual. Damask brought a [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] subject to Kamino to inquire about using the Yinchorri as the template for a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Army/Legends|army]]. Ultimately, she and two other Kaminoan scientists were unable to use their [[Scientist/Legends|science]] to take out the Yinchorri's natural aggression, and the [[Species/Legends|species]] was abandoned in favor of [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ko Sai became [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief Scientist]] of the creation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. It was her responsibility to ensure that the clones were of the highest quality, overseeing all the biological aspects of the project. She also directed the "processing" of the clones that failed to meet her expectations.

Following the [[First Battle of Kamino]], Ko Sai told [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] more about the source of funding for the army&mdash;a man called [[Dooku/Legends|Tyranus]], who happened to be [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku, a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. At some point, she met with the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who wanted her research to extend his life indefinitely. She noted that he disturbed her.

A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and a half into the war, Ko Sai defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and soon, [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] were deployed to find the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] before she could reveal any cloning information to the Confederacy. However, she quickly abandoned the Separatists as well and became independent, fleeing both the Separatists and the Republic to continue her work in secrecy.

[[Kal Skirata]], his [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-ARCs]], [[Ordo Skirata|Ordo]], [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]], along with [[Walon Vau]] also took up the search for the scientist in the hopes that Ko Sai would be able to engineer a full life span for the clone army. After a prolonged search, they found her on [[Dorumaa]], hiding in an underground laboratory.

[[File:Ko-sai.jpg|thumb|left|Ko Sai.]]
Sai was unwilling to help them, believing that Skirata would sell her research for to the highest bidder. Ordo, seemingly in a fit of rage, destroyed her research in front of her, leaving the devastated Sai without a legacy. Unknown to her, Ordo and Mereel had made a backup copy of her research, in case Ko Sai never gave them the information they wanted. Without her, they could bring the research to other cloners, such as [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] or the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommites]]. Ko Sai, however, was kept ignorant of this fact, in order to leave her broken and more willing to cooperate, hoping for an opportunity to start over with her beloved work.

In exchange for blood samples and multipotent stem cells from [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] and [[Venku Skirata|Venku's]] umbilical cord, Ko Sai surrendered some of the gene sequences that would allow for the age reversal to take place. After studying Venku's genome, Ko Sai committed suicide by hanging herself from a rafter, leaving Etain a note thanking her for the opportunity to study such a fascinating genome. Mereel, along with [[Jaing Skirata|Jaing]] and Ordo, prepared her for transport to Kamino, last seen moving her corpse into a barn with vibroblades drawn. Skirata later delivered Ko Sai's head to Delta Squad, who were to offer it as proof of her death to convince the Republic and Palpatine to give up searching for Sai and her research.

===Post-mortem===
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Goran Beviin]] told [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] that someone killed Ko Sai, saying that most of her corpse was returned to Kamino in pieces, leading Boba to believe that her death was an act of revenge.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> Later it was discovered that part of her hide was made into a pair of fine gray gloves worn by [[Jaing Skirata]], one of the Null-class ARCs.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We had a dirtbag geneticist like you once. Yes, a mad ''Mando'' scientist. Liked experimenting with kids. He's been dust for millennia, but we still know what the name ''Demagol'' means. The irony is that it can mean either 'sculptor of flesh' or 'butcher', so I reckon you two would have had a lot of cozy chats about how to screw up living beings.|Kal Skirata to Ko Sai, noting the latter's similarities with cruel [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] [[Demagol]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: True Colors" />}}
Ko Sai, like most Kaminoans, was a very cold and calculating [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] due to [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] culture. Kal Skirata told Etain a story about a Kaminoan child who was born with green eyes, whose mother had hidden it in one of the clone training areas. Kaminoan society permitted only [[Color/Legends|gray]], blue, or yellow eyes to determine caste, so Ko Sai had the child found and killed only because it possessed an undesirable trait. She referred to all of her clones as "units". After two years of experimentation with the first batch of clones, the six Null ARCS, she ordered them to be terminated because they had a flaw; they stubbornly questioned authority. They were saved by Kal Skirata and Jango Fett, ostensibly for use as special intelligence operatives. Skirata raised and trained them personally, but all six never fully recovered from the horrors of Ko Sai's experiments. Even when held in captivity by Skirata and the Nulls, she was still her old self; in order to spite her clone captors, she committed suicide to deny them information.
